conviction_note: Most of Q3 is already public through Fineco's monthly net-sales releases (Jul/Aug/Sep net sales and brokerage revenue estimates), the 2026 guide is qualitative and was raised in July, and I found no unpriced company-level number. What the release adds that the market has not seen is Q3 net financial income (helped by the ECB's 2026 hikes, hurt slightly by about EUR 0.4bn of deposit outflow), October net sales, and any tweak to the 2026 outlook. abs_move 3.5 is the pre-released-period base, nudged up because Fineco has adjusted its guide at its last few prints (its Q3 2025 print moved +4.65%). p_up 52 is a near-coin-flip. The findings sum to +0.35 and the scaled number is +0.14: both are small and they agree in sign.

findings.finding: The ECB raised its deposit rate twice in 2026, to 2.5%, and held on 29 Oct. Fineco's July guide names 'rates increase' as a driver of NII growth, so Q3 NII (which is not pre-released) and the NII line of the outlook lean up.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Outlook tweaks moved the stock: +4.65% on 2025-11-05 (Q3 2025, 'guidance FY25 leggermente migliorata'), +1.28% on 2026-07-30 (outlook 'ulteriormente migliorato'), -1.78% on 2026-05-07 (Yahoo daily closes, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/FBK.MI?range=2y&interval=1d)
findings.original_quote: il tasso sui depositi (il tasso mediante il quale la BCE orienta la politica monetaria) è rimasto fermo al 2,5% [the deposit rate, the rate through which the ECB steers monetary policy, held at 2.5%]; company: 'Margine finanziario: atteso in crescita grazie alla combinazione di raccolta positiva dei depositi e ai tassi di interesse di mercato più elevati' [NII expected to grow on positive deposit inflows and higher market rates]
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The rate path is public and 27 analysts model it. What is not priced is how much of the September hike management folds into the outlook. If it were already in, the stock would not sit 9% below its 60-day level and about 6% below its 30 Jul close of 23.65.
findings.independence: Fineco's own 2Q26 presentation ('Net financial income: growing thanks to the combination of positive deposit net sales and rates increase'), https://images.finecobank.com/docs/pdf/pub/corporate/investors/2Q26-Results.pdf. Same company, different document.

findings.finding: Q3 deposits flowed out on net (July ~-EUR 0.3bn, August -EUR 193m, September +EUR 108m, about -EUR 0.4bn in total; YTD to August +EUR 102m against +EUR 840m a year earlier), which weakens the 'positive deposit net sales' half of the NII guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: NII-led quarters have moved under 2%: Q1 2026 (NII +1% y/y) -1.78% on 2026-05-07
findings.original_quote: La componente diretta è pari a € -193 milioni, influenzata sia dalle imposte pagate dai clienti nel mese, sia da una attività di investimento molto sostenuta [Direct deposits were -EUR 193m, affected by taxes clients paid in the month and by very strong investment activity]
findings.why_not_priced: It is pre-released monthly data, so the outflows themselves are priced. Only the NII arithmetic is not, and on a ~EUR 32bn deposit stock about 1.3% of volume is small next to the rate effect.

findings.finding: Q3 commercial momentum is strong but already published: net sales of about EUR 4.1bn (Jul 1.7 + Aug 0.96 + Sep 1.45), AuM inflows of about EUR 1.2bn, and brokerage revenue of about EUR 70.6m, flat q/q and about +7% y/y implied.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 6 Oct 2026 September release day closed +0.93% (Yahoo daily)
findings.original_quote: La raccolta amministrata è pari a 980 milioni di euro, contribuendo in modo significativo a ricavi brokerage molto solidi (stimati a circa 20 milioni di euro) nonostante gli scarsi volumi di mercato nel mese. I ricavi brokerage da inizio anno sono pari a circa 211 milioni di euro (+13% a/a). [AuC net sales were EUR 980m, contributing significantly to very solid brokerage revenue (est. ~EUR 20m) despite thin market volumes in the month. YTD brokerage revenue is ~EUR 211m, +13% y/y.]
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced. The company pre-releases these lines every month, so they are worth 0 on results day unless the final figures revise the estimates.

findings.finding: The ECB's SREP 2026 cut Fineco's P2R by 10bp to 1.90% (CET1 requirement 8.60% against 23.18% actual), which marginally adds to the excess-capital debate. The binding constraint is the leverage ratio (5.02% against the >4.5% target), not CET1.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction. Management deferred any excess-capital return in 2025 ('capitale extra in standby', https://www.milanofinanza.it/news/fineco-utile-a-11-foti-capitale-extra-in-standby-2664421)
findings.original_quote: Il P2R è stato fissato all' 1,90%, in miglioramento di 10 punti base rispetto al precedente livello del 2,00%. [The P2R was set at 1.90%, an improvement of 10bp on the previous 2.00%.]
findings.why_not_priced: Public for two weeks and immaterial to a 23% CET1 bank whose constraint is leverage. It matters only if management uses the call to reopen capital return.
